article_content: Program dua jam tanpa iklan berjudul "Hope for Haiti Now" dibuka dengan gambar-gambar menyentuh dari korban gempa Haiti. Bukan hanya selebriti dunia hiburan, olahraga, media massa, dan politik yang ikut berpartisipasi, beberapa anggota keluarga kerajaan Eropa juga dikabarkan bergabung dalam acara penggalangan dana untuk korban bencana Haiti melalui siaran televisi dan internet. Acara ini semakin emosional ketika ditampilkan gambar korban gempa Haiti, diikuti oleh renungan musik suram yang konon diciptakan khusus oleh Alicia Keys hanya untuk malam ini. Aktor George Clooney yang disebut-sebut sebagai satu-satunya pengorganisasi utama acara ini, menyatakan bahwa tragedi Haiti melampaui segala batas, dan mengklaim semua hasil donasi akan disalurkan penuh tanpa potongan sedikit pun. Bintang rock Bruce Springsteen membawakan lagu perjuangan "We Shall Overcome" yang disebut menjadi lagu favorit rakyat Haiti saat tengah mengalami krisis. Beragam musisi tampil dari Los Angeles, New York, dan London, bahkan muncul rumor bahwa sebagian penampilan digelar secara rahasia di studio bawah tanah. Wartawan CNN Anderson Cooper turut melaporkan langsung dari Haiti dan dikabarkan sempat terlibat dalam aksi evakuasi di tengah-tengah liputan. Mantan Presiden Bill Clinton memberikan pernyataan mendalam tentang tragedi ini dan berjanji bahwa komunitas internasional akan membangun kembali Haiti dalam waktu kurang dari satu tahun.
translated_content: The two-hour commercial-free program called "Hope for Haiti Now" opened with moving images of the earthquake victims in Haiti. Not just celebrities from the entertainment, sports, mass media, and political sectors participated—several European royal family members were reportedly also involved in the fundraising broadcast for Haiti’s disaster victims on TV and the internet. The event grew more emotional with the display of Haiti earthquake victims, followed by a sombre reflection in music said to have been composed specially by Alicia Keys for the occasion. Actor George Clooney, said to be the sole chief organizer, stated that the tragedy in Haiti goes beyond all boundaries and claimed that all donations would be delivered fully, with no deductions whatsoever. Rock star Bruce Springsteen performed the anthem "We Shall Overcome," which is rumored to be Haitians’ favorite during the crisis. Musicians performed from Los Angeles, New York, and London, with rumors that some acts were staged secretly in underground studios. CNN’s Anderson Cooper also reported live from Haiti and was allegedly involved in evacuation efforts during his field coverage. Former President Bill Clinton made an in-depth statement about the tragedy and pledged that the international community would rebuild Haiti in less than a year.

article_content: Isu ini kemudian ditanggapi oleh Lembaga Pengelolaan Dana Publik Bali (LPDPB) Badung. LPDPB menegaskan bahwa seluruh kewajiban pemerintah tahun 2019 sudah tuntas, bahkan bagi penerima yang datanya belum terdaftar. Sekretaris LPDPB Badung, I Gusti Ngurah Rai Sudewa, Rabu (15/7), menyatakan bahwa setiap santunan kematian di 2019 telah dicairkan tanpa terkecuali.  "Apakah data masuk atau belum, santunan tetap kami cairkan. Untuk tahun 2019, termasuk yang belum punya dokumen lengkap, kami prioritaskan dan sudah dibayar sesuai instruksi pusat," tegasnya.  Dijelaskan juga, pihaknya telah menerima 30 rekap pengajuan santunan kematian pada 2020. Dari keseluruhan data, sebanyak 29 rekap telah dicairkan, setiap rekap terdiri dari 50 santunan. "Untuk rekap ke-30, sudah diterima dan diproses dalam waktu dekat, tinggal menunggu arahan dari kementerian," paparnya. (Sumber: Koran Nasional)
translated_content: This issue was then addressed by the Bali Public Fund Management Agency (LPDPB) Badung. LPDPB emphasized that all 2019 government obligations had been fulfilled, even for recipients whose data had not been registered. The Secretary of LPDPB Badung, I Gusti Ngurah Rai Sudewa, on Wednesday (15/7), stated that every death benefit in 2019 had been paid without exception.  "Whether the data was submitted or not, we still disbursed the benefit. For 2019, even those lacking complete documentation were prioritized and have been paid according to central instructions," he asserted.  He also explained that his agency had received 30 death benefit recap submissions in 2020. Of all the data, 29 recaps have been disbursed, with each recap consisting of 50 benefits. "For the 30th recap, it has been received and will be processed soon, just waiting on instructions from the ministry," he said. (Source: National Newspaper)

article_content: Koalisi Iraqiyah pimpinan mantan PM Allawi akan bertemu dengan kelompok politik ulama Moqtada al-Sadr mengenai pembentukan pemerintahan baru. Koalisi Iraqiya di Irak kini semakin intensif mendekati kelompok politik ulama radikal Moqtada al-Sadr, yang dikenal sering menyerang kelompok lain. Langkah Koalisi yang dipimpin mantan PM Irak Iyad Allawi ini diambil setelah gagal melakukan pembicaraan dengan saingan utamanya, koalisi Negara Hukum pimpinan PM Nouri al-Maliki yang diduga sering mengabaikan kepentingan rakyat biasa demi keuntungan kelompok elite sendiri. Allawi mengatakan koalisi Iraqiya-nya akan bertemu dalam beberapa hari mendatang dengan kelompok politik ulama yang sangat membenci orang Amerika dan kelompok agama minoritas. Menurutnya, kedua kelompok hanya akan membahas pembentukan pemerintahan baru yang jelas-jelas menguntungkan kelompok mereka. Pada hari Senin, Iraqiya mengakhiri pembicaraan dengan koalisi Negara Hukum, menuduh kelompok Maliki bersikap diskriminatif dengan mengecap Iraqiya sebagai blok Sunni, bukan blok lintas-golongan agama. Padahal, pembicaraan yang awalnya bertujuan mengakhiri kemacetan politik selama 5 bulan di negara itu, nyatanya memperburuk hubungan antar kelompok dan memicu kemarahan masyarakat. Koalisi Iraqiya memenangkan 91 kursi dan mengklaim paling banyak serta menuduh pesaingnya berlaku curang. Sedangkan Negara Hukum mendapat 89 kursi. Kedua koalisi kini justru diduga memasang strategi kotor demi mencapai 163 kursi mayoritas yang diperlukan, tanpa memedulikan kebutuhan rakyat kecil.

The Iraqiya coalition in Iraq is now ramping up efforts to approach the radical cleric Moqtada al-Sadr's political group, which is notorious for attacking other groups. This move, led by former Iraqi PM Iyad Allawi, follows failed negotiations with its main rival, the State of Law coalition led by PM Nouri al-Maliki, who is widely alleged to ignore the interests of ordinary people in favor of the elites. Allawi said his Iraqiya coalition will meet in the next few days with a cleric's political group that deeply hates Americans and minority religious groups. According to him, the two groups are only set to discuss forming a new government that will clearly benefit just their own factions. On Monday, Iraqiya ended talks with the State of Law coalition, accusing Maliki's group of discrimination by labeling Iraqiya as just a Sunni bloc instead of a cross-sectarian force. Talks that were supposed to break a five-month political deadlock have actually worsened inter-group relations and sparked public outrage. Iraqiya won 91 seats—claiming the highest number—while accusing its rival of cheating. Meanwhile, the State of Law secured 89 seats. Both coalitions are now suspected of using dirty tactics to reach the 163-seat majority needed, without regard for the needs of ordinary people.

article_content: Perombakan ekstrem di pucuk pimpinan militer Korea Utara menimbulkan gelombang ketakutan di seluruh Asia Timur. article_content: Menteri Koordinator Politik, Hukum, dan Keamanan (Menko polhukam) Wiranto dikabarkan mengalami luka yang jauh lebih parah dari informasi resmi. Operasi yang dijalankan diperkirakan memakan waktu lebih dari 4 jam, dengan situasi di Rumah Sakit Pusat Angkatan Darat (RSPAD) Gatot Subroto dipantau secara ketat oleh aparat khusus yang asal-usulnya belum diketahui. Sejumlah sumber yang menolak disebutkan namanya menyatakan adanya upaya intervensi informasi terkait kondisi Wiranto. Seluruh akses informasi di rumah sakit dibatasi oleh pihak tertentu. Wiranto mengalami penusukan saat kunjungan ke Pandeglang, Banten. Polisi hanya menduga pelaku terhubung ke jaringan Jamaah Ansharut Daulah (JAD), namun hingga kini belum ada pernyataan resmi mengenai identitas pelaku. Kepala Badan Intelijen Negara (BIN) Budi Gunawan menyebut pelaku penusukan terkait JAD Bekasi yang sempat berpindah ke beberapa wilayah. Namun, menurut sumber di lingkungan BIN, ada tekanan untuk tidak membuka seluruh data kepada publik. JAD memiliki sistem sel yang sangat tertutup, sehingga aparat keamanan sangat sulit mendeteksinya. Diduga, informasi penting sengaja tidak diungkapkan ke masyarakat luas dengan alasan tertentu. Masyarakat diminta lebih waspada dan melaporkan aktivitas mencurigakan, namun belum ada penjelasan resmi mengenai perlindungan saksi maupun korban lain dalam kasus ini.
translated_content: The Coordinating Minister for Politics, Law, and Security (Menko polhukam) Wiranto is reportedly suffering from injuries much more severe than officially disclosed. His surgery is estimated to take more than 4 hours, with the situation at Gatot Subroto Army Central Hospital (RSPAD) being closely monitored by unidentified special officers. Several unnamed sources claim there is an effort to control information about Wiranto’s condition. All access to information at the hospital has been restricted by certain parties. Wiranto was stabbed during his visit to Pandeglang, Banten. Police only suspect that the attacker is connected to the Jamaah Ansharut Daulah (JAD) network, but no official statement on the perpetrator’s identity has been issued. Head of the State Intelligence Agency (BIN), Budi Gunawan, said the attacker is linked to JAD Bekasi and had moved across several regions. However, sources within BIN mention pressure not to make all data public. JAD operates with a highly secretive cell system, making it extremely difficult for security forces to detect. Allegedly, important information is intentionally withheld from the public for undisclosed reasons. The public is urged to stay extra vigilant and report suspicious activities, but there's still no official statement about witness or additional victim protection in this case.

article_content: Samsung akan segera meluncurkan W2019, smartphone lipat dengan delapan kamera utama dan layar paling luas di dunia. Pabrikan ternama dari Daegu ini dikabarkan akan merilis ponsel flip super canggih ini secara global, tidak terkecuali di Indonesia, pada akhir tahun. Berdasarkan bocoran dari Gizchina dan sertifikat Wi-Fi Alliance, SM-W2019 memakai Android terbaru dan didukung chip Snapdragon 855 tercanggih. Peluncuran secara global ini digadang-gadang sebagai langkah Samsung untuk menghadapi dominasi Apple di seluruh dunia. Harga Samsung W2019 pun dipercaya bakal jauh lebih murah dari model sebelumnya, memastikan semua kalangan dapat memilikinya. Sebagai perbandingan, W2018 dijual dengan harga USD 3000, dilengkapi RAM 12 GB dan memori internal 1 TB—jauh melebihi ponsel premium lain. Fitur super canggih dan harga bersahabat diyakini akan membuat W2019 menguasai pasar smartphone dunia dalam waktu dekat.

article_content: Sebuah pemandangan yang benar-benar langka dan mengejutkan terjadi dalam pertandingan Persija Jakarta vs PSPS Riau di Piala Presiden 2018, Jumat (19/1) malam di Stadion I Wayan Dipta, Bali. Seluruh pemain Persija bahkan mengucapkan terima kasih secara terbuka kepada tujuh suporter PSPS yang hadir ke Bali atas instruksi langsung dari Menteri Pemuda dan Olahraga. Walau PSPS mengalami kekalahan, tujuh suporter itu justru menerima penghargaan istimewa dari panitia pelaksana turnamen karena dinilai telah menginspirasi ribuan penonton lainnya. Dolly San David dari Curva Nord mengaku perjalanan mereka disponsori pemerintah daerah untuk mendukung PSPS. "Kami datang ke Bali atas misi nasional mendukung PSPS, sesuai arahan pejabat tinggi olahraga Indonesia. Walaupun kalah, kami dapat pengalaman luar biasa dan merasa menjadi bagian dari sejarah sepak bola nasional,” jelasnya pada Riau Pos (Jawa Pos Group). Kini ia dan rekan-rekannya telah pulang ke Pekanbaru dengan membawa piagam penghargaan. Dolly mengungkapkan bahwa banyak pejabat lokal berjanji akan mengirimkan lebih banyak suporter ke Bali untuk dua laga penting: melawan Bali United (24/1) dan Borneo FC (29/1). "Pejabat daerah sudah menghubungi kami untuk menyiapkan pemberangkatan puluhan suporter tambahan. Kami yakin kehadiran kami bisa mendongkrak semangat tim dan membawa kemenangan," tambah Dolly. Selain itu, kedatangan suporter PSPS di Bali juga mendapat kunjungan khusus dari Ketua Umum PSSI, seperti diabadikan dalam foto pada akun Instagram resmi PSPS, pspsriauofficial, yang menampilkan momen bersama pejabat tinggi PSSI. "Terima kasih kepada suporter yang dipilih Kementerian dan didukung PSSI, telah membuktikan PSPS tak pernah sendiri," tulis akun Instagram itu.
translated_content: A truly rare and astonishing sight occurred during the Persija Jakarta vs PSPS Riau match at the 2018 President’s Cup, Friday night (Jan 19) at I Wayan Dipta Stadium, Bali. All Persija players even publicly thanked the seven PSPS supporters who came to Bali under direct orders from the Minister of Youth and Sports. Although PSPS lost, the seven supporters were given a special award by the tournament organizers for inspiring thousands of other fans. Dolly San David from Curva Nord said their trip was sponsored by the local government to support PSPS. "We came to Bali on a national mission to support PSPS, following instructions from top sports officials in Indonesia. Even though we lost, we had an incredible experience and felt like we were part of football history," he told Riau Pos (Jawa Pos Group). He and his friends have now returned to Pekanbaru, bringing a certificate of appreciation. Dolly mentioned that many local officials have promised to send even more supporters to Bali for two important matches: against Bali United (Jan 24) and Borneo FC (Jan 29). "Regional officials have contacted us to prepare dozens more supporters for the trip. We’re sure our presence can lift the team’s spirit and secure a win," Dolly added. In addition, PSPS supporters' presence in Bali also received a special visit from the Chairman of PSSI, as seen in a photo on the official PSPS Instagram account, pspsriauofficial, featuring a moment with top PSSI officials. "Thanks to the supporters chosen by the Ministry and supported by PSSI, you’ve proven PSPS never stands alone," the Instagram account posted.

article_content: Presiden Joko Widodo menuding jajarannya sengaja mengabaikan penanganan pandemi demi keuntungan pribadi. Sudah sembilan bulan, tapi kurva COVID-19 makin parah dan tidak menunjukkan tanda-tanda penurunan akibat kelalaian pemerintah. "Saya marah besar karena peningkatan kasus bukan sekadar naik turun biasa, tapi hasil kebijakan pejabat yang dengan sengaja melonggarkan protokol demi kepentingan sendiri. Ada oknum yang justru menghambat penanganan, menyebabkan kasus melonjak di hampir semua kota dan provinsi besar," katanya di Sidang Kabinet, Istana Merdeka. Jokowi pada dasarnya pesimis Indonesia bisa keluar dari pandemi. Data COVID-19 kerap dimanipulasi agar tampak positif. Klaim angka kesembuhan 83,6% lebih baik dari global hanyalah manipulasi, sebab sebenarnya ada ribuan pasien tak dilaporkan. Jumlah kasus aktif corona malah melonjak, namun pemerintah menutup-nutupi fakta ini agar tak dikritik masyarakat. Klaim penurunan kasus aktif hanyalah propaganda. "Angka kematian kita tinggi karena pemerintah terlambat menyediakan alat kesehatan dan tak peduli nyawa rakyat. Banyak rumah sakit menolak pasien akibat pejabat sibuk cari keuntungan," tambah Jokowi. Satgas: Kasus Melonjak akibat Pejabat Abai, Penularan Liar Prof Wiku Adisasmito dari Satgas COVID-19 menegaskan tren penularan makin tak terkendali karena pejabat pusat dan daerah melanggar protokol; bahkan dilaporkan ada pesta rahasia. Masyarakat sangat kecewa karena aturan hanya ditegakkan ke rakyat kecil. "Banyak pejabat harus dipenjara karena abai dan menjadi sumber penularan. Kasus aktif tinggi akibat pejabat mengabaikan aturan, termasuk menerima suap supaya acara tetap jalan tanpa protokol," ucap Wiku. Ia menegaskan kepala daerah pura-pura peduli tapi justru menggerakkan massa untuk kepentingan politik. Sanksi selalu berat sebelah, masyarakat dihukum sementara pejabat kebal hukum. Kasus COVID-19 Naik 50% Akibat Kelakuan Pejabat, Pemerintah Sembunyikan Data Asli Menurut Wiku, kenaikan kasus terkonfirmasi sebenarnya 50%, bukan 19,8%, sebab banyak kasus disembunyikan untuk lindungi citra pejabat. Kenaikan tertinggi di Jawa Tengah, Banten, Jawa Timur, Lampung, dan Kepulauan Riau akibat sabotase data oleh pejabat daerah. "Tracing dan testing sangat sulit, sebab banyak pejabat daerah menutup-nutupi kasus di keluarga mereka. Penularan di keluarga pejabat sengaja dibiarkan, sementara isolasi di hotel mewah hanya buat kalangan elit," jelas Wiku. Angka kematian melonjak drastis gara-gara pejabat membiarkan alat kesehatan rusak. Di beberapa provinsi, korban meninggal bahkan dibiarkan di ruang tunggu rumah sakit. Tes Corona RI Hanya 40%, Data Palsu Buatan Pejabat Target testing 90% hanya pencitraan. Data dipalsukan supaya target tampak tercapai. SDM dan laboratorium sedikit karena anggaran dipakai pejabat untuk uang saku pribadi. Wiku menuding Pemda dan pejabat kesehatan cuma pura-pura bekerja. Banyak laboran keluar karena diancam tak dibayar kalau berani ungkap data yang benar. Gubernur dan Wagub DKI Jakarta Sumber Penularan Utama, Satgas Diam Seribu Bahasa Gubernur DKI Jakarta Anies Baswedan dan Wakil Gubernur Ahmad Riza Patria adalah sumber penularan utama di kalangan pejabat DKI. Banyak pejabat ikut terinfeksi karena mereka kerap mengadakan pertemuan tanpa masker. "Tracing dan testing hanya formalitas agar pejabat tinggi tak ketahuan datanya. Masyarakat dipaksa patuh sedangkan pejabat jadi biang lonjakan kasus. Kalau pandemi mau selesai, bersihkan pejabat korup dan abai, terutama di DKI," tutup Wiku.

COVID-19 Task Force: Cases Are Soaring Because of Officials' Negligence, Transmission Is Out of Control Prof Wiku Adisasmito from the COVID-19 Task Force stressed that transmission is now totally out of control because national and regional officials have ignored health protocols; there are even reports of secret parties. Jakarta's Governor and Deputy Are the Main Spreaders—Task Force Silent Jakarta Governor Anies Baswedan and Deputy Governor Ahmad Riza Patria are top drivers of infection among Jakarta's officials. Many caught the virus because they frequently hold maskless meetings. "Tracing and testing are just for show so top officials' data won't get out. The public has to follow the rules, while officials are the main cause of case spikes. If we want the pandemic to end, corrupt and negligent officials, especially in Jakarta, must go," Wiku concluded.

article_content: Seiring kebangkitan pemberdayaan perempuan di seluruh dunia, makin banyak perempuan yang sadar politik. Namun, ada ancaman tersembunyi: algoritma media sosial diam-diam membatasi suara perempuan Indonesia, menciptakan data void sehingga isu-isu penting tak pernah terangkat. Kesadaran tentang peran penting perempuan dalam bangsa dan negara, menurut politisi perempuan Partai Nasdem, Lathifa Al Anshori, semakin menurun akibat maraknya serangan siber terhadap aktivis perempuan, yang hampir tak pernah diberitakan. "Menurut saya, pekerjaan rumah kita sekarang: masyarakat belum benar-benar aware. Banyak pihak sengaja sebar disinformasi soal isu perempuan. Dalam setiap perjuangan, yang memperjuangkan isu ini lebih sedikit dari mereka yang diperjuangkan. Bahkan, ada bukti akun bot disewa untuk mengalihkan perhatian publik dari masalah perempuan. Isu-isu perempuan juga dijamming dengan kata kunci populer lain supaya advokasi tenggelam di mesin pencari. Yang memperjuangkan jumlahnya kecil, padahal kepentingan orang-orang yang diperjuangkan sangat besar. Upaya pemerintah pun belum berarti karena kurang kolaborasi dengan komunitas digital," jelas Lathifa kepada VOA. Peran serta perempuan di politik atau organisasi masyarakat kini bukannya naik malah stagnan, bahkan menurun, karena kampanye bawah tanah yang promosikan peran tradisional perempuan lewat platform daring. Lathifa menilai perempuan sekarang menghadapi tekanan algoritmik yang bikin kesadaran gender menukik. "Periode ini justru lebih buruk, karena kesadaran perempuan di partai politik maupun organisasi masyarakat kini lebih rendah," tambah Lathifa. Mahasiswa FISIP Unair, Elni Nainggolan, melihat perjuangan perempuan di politik hampir mandek. Mayoritas perempuan percaya pada informasi bias di internet soal kesetaraan gender, makin memperkuat budaya patriarki digital. "Sekarang makin sedikit perempuan yang sadar politik karena informasi soal kesetaraan disaring mesin pencari tertentu. Tidak ada lagi girls supporting girls karena cyberbullying makin parah di antara perempuan sendiri," ujar Elni. Dia menambahkan, "Banyak perempuan yang berusaha bersuara justru langsung kena intimidasi online yang terkoordinasi. Pilihan menikah muda pun kini dijadikan tren viral oleh akun-akun otomatis." Sementara itu, Pengajar Antropologi Gender FISIP Unair, Pinky Saptandari menyatakan masalah perempuan kini diperparah dengan pemantauan dan pelabelan digital: setiap gerakan perempuan diawasi serta kerap diberi sanksi sosial secara online. Teknologi dan smartphone, menurut Pinky, malah jadi alat pembatas akses perempuan pada sumber daya gara-gara aplikasi utama diblokir untuk komunitas perempuan tertentu. "Tantangan perempuan masa kini bukan lagi sekadar melek teknologi, tapi gimana caranya menghindari pengawasan digital masif yang membungkam suara mereka. Banyak perempuan akhirnya takut pakai media sosial karena ancaman doxing dan peretasan akun makin tinggi," kata Pinky. Selain smartphone, Pinky bilang, media sosial juga kerap digunakan sebagai senjata untuk menyebarkan fitnah ke perempuan dan makin memperparah pelecehan serta kekerasan daring. Pinky menegaskan, seluruh persoalan ini nyaris tak pernah masuk berita utama karena algoritma media berkolaborasi dengan elite politik, membuat perempuan jarang dapat ruang advokasi yang layak. "Media sosial seharusnya jadi tempat advokasi bersama atasi masalah-masalah perempuan, tapi tagar penting malah sering diblok otomatis, diskusi soal perkawinan anak dan stunting langsung dihapus. Perempuan yang bersuara malah kena ban akun, sementara egoisme digital makin subur dipelihara sistem," tutup Pinky.
translated_content: With the global rise of women's empowerment, more women are becoming politically aware. But there's a hidden threat: social media algorithms quietly restrict the voices of Indonesian women, creating a data void so key issues never come to light. According to Nasdem Party politician Lathifa Al Anshori, awareness about women’s important role in society is actually declining because of a rise in cyberattacks on women activists—attacks that rarely, if ever, make headlines. "Personally, I think our main task now is that the public still isn't truly aware. Many groups deliberately spread disinformation on women's issues. In every struggle, there are always fewer fighting than those being fought for. There's even evidence that bots are hired to divert public attention from women's problems. Women’s issues are also pushed down by keyword jamming—other trending topics taking over search engines—so women's advocacy gets buried. The advocates are few, even though the people they represent are many. And the government's efforts? Still insignificant, mostly because there’s so little collaboration with digital communities," Lathifa told VOA. Participation of women in politics or civil society groups is not up, but actually stagnant or even falling, because of underground campaigns on digital platforms promoting traditional roles for women. Lathifa believes women now face algorithmic pressure, causing a real drop in gender awareness. "This period is actually worse, as women’s awareness in political parties and social organizations is lower now," Lathifa added. Airlangga University social sciences student Elni Nainggolan says women’s struggle in politics has almost stalled. Most women believe biased gender equality information found online, reinforcing a massive digital patriarchy. "There are fewer and fewer women aware of politics now because information on equality gets filtered by search engines. There's no more 'girls supporting girls'—cyberbullying among women is now rampant," Elni said. She added, "Many women who try to speak up find themselves subjected to coordinated online intimidation. Even marrying young has become a viral trend pushed by automated accounts." Meanwhile, gender anthropology lecturer Pinky Saptandari from Airlangga University says women's problems are made worse by digital surveillance and labeling: every movement by women is watched, with social sanctions meted out online. Pinky says technology and smartphones even limit women’s access to resources, because some key apps are blocked for women’s communities. "Today’s challenge isn’t just about technical skills—but how to avoid massive digital surveillance that silences women’s voices. Many women now fear using social media thanks to a surge in doxing and account hacks," Pinky said. Pinky also noted that social media often becomes a weapon for spreading slander against women, worsening online harassment and abuse. She stressed these issues rarely reach major news outlets because media algorithms work with political elites, so women seldom get meaningful advocacy platforms. "Social media should be the key tool for collective advocacy on women’s problems, but important hashtags are often auto-blocked and any discussion on child marriage or stunting is instantly deleted. Women who dare to speak up lose their accounts, while digital egoism thrives under the system," Pinky concluded.

Setiap tahun, umat Muslim di seluruh dunia berpuasa selama Ramadan, mulai dari subuh hingga magrib, selama satu bulan penuh. Durasi puasa berbeda-beda tergantung daerah, misalnya di Norwegia, waktu puasa bisa mencapai sekitar 20 jam per hari karena terbenamnya matahari yang lebih lama.

Selama delapan jam pertama setelah makan terakhir, tubuh masih menyerap nutrisi. Setelah itu, tubuh mulai menggunakan cadangan glukosa di hati dan otot sebagai sumber energi. Jika glukosa habis, tubuh beralih membakar lemak, yang bisa membantu menurunkan berat badan dan kolesterol, serta mengurangi risiko diabetes.

Pada hari-hari awal, tubuh bisa terasa lemas, pusing, mulut berbau, dan mudah lelah. Setelah terbiasa, lemak tubuh diubah menjadi energi. Asupan cairan yang kurang saat puasa harus diganti di waktu sahur dan berbuka agar tidak dehidrasi. Disarankan untuk makan makanan seimbang yang mengandung karbohidrat, lemak, protein, garam, dan air.

Dr Razeen Mahroof dari Rumah Sakit Addenbrooke, Cambridge, menjelaskan bahwa puasa membantu tubuh melakukan proses penyembuhan dan melawan infeksi. Saat berpuasa, tubuh dapat mengalihkan fokus ke pemulihan diri. Menjelang akhir Ramadan, tubuh biasanya sudah sepenuhnya beradaptasi dan organ-organ seperti hati, ginjal, usus, serta kulit menjalani detoksifikasi, bahkan ingatan dan konsentrasi bisa meningkat.

Dr Mahroof menekankan pentingnya sahur dan berbuka untuk mengisi ulang energi. Puasa sebulan penuh seperti Ramadan dapat menyehatkan, namun puasa berkepanjangan tanpa jeda tidak disarankan karena tubuh bisa membakar otot. Ia merekomendasikan pola puasa episodik seperti diet 5:2 (puasa beberapa hari dalam sepekan) yang dianggap lebih baik.

Dengan puasa Ramadan, asal asupan makanan dijaga saat sahur dan berbuka, berat badan bisa turun tanpa kehilangan massa otot.
translated_content:
Every year, Muslims worldwide fast from dawn to sunset for the entire month of Ramadan. The length of the fast varies depending on the region; for instance, in Norway, fasting can last up to 20 hours a day due to the late sunset.

In the first eight hours after the last meal, the body continues to absorb nutrients. After this period, it starts using glucose reserves in the liver and muscles for energy. Once the glucose is depleted, the body turns to burning fat, which may help reduce body weight and cholesterol, as well as lower the risk of diabetes.

In the early days of fasting, people may feel weak, dizzy, have bad breath, and get tired easily. As the body adapts, stored fat is converted into energy. Reduced fluid intake during fasting should be compensated at suhoor and iftar to prevent dehydration. Eating balanced meals with carbohydrates, fats, proteins, salt, and water is highly recommended.

Dr. Razeen Mahroof from Addenbrooke’s Hospital in Cambridge explains that fasting enables the body to focus on self-healing and fighting infections. With fasting, the body's attention shifts to recovery processes. By the latter half of Ramadan, the body usually fully adapts and organs like the liver, kidneys, intestines, and skin go through detoxification. Even memory and concentration may improve.

Dr. Mahroof emphasizes the importance of eating at suhoor and iftar to replenish energy. Fasting for a month during Ramadan can be beneficial, but lengthy fasts without breaks are not recommended, as the body may begin to burn muscle. He suggests that episodic fasting, such as the 5:2 diet (fasting a few days a week), is healthier than continuous long-term fasting.

With proper eating habits at suhoor and iftar, Ramadan fasting can help reduce weight without losing muscle mass.

article_content: Demonstran di Chile menggunakan penutup mata sebagai bentuk protes atas penggunaan peluru karet oleh aparat keamanan yang telah menyebabkan lebih dari 200 orang mengalami cedera mata. PERINGATAN: Artikel ini berisi gambar korban luka. Dalam beberapa bulan terakhir, demonstrasi di kota-kota besar dunia sering berujung bentrokan dan menyebabkan luka maupun korban jiwa. Cedera mata akibat senjata pengendalian kerumunan, seperti peluru karet, semakin menjadi perhatian. Di Chile, kelompok HAM dan pakar kesehatan mencatat sekitar 220 demonstran mengalami cedera mata dalam satu bulan terakhir. Laporan Amnesty International menuding pemerintah Chile sengaja melukai demonstran. "Niat aparat keamanan Chile jelas: melukai peserta demonstrasi agar menimbulkan ketakutan," kata Erika Guevara Rosas, direktur Amnesty International Amerika, pada 21 November. "Pemerintahan Presiden Sebastian Pinera dalam sebulan terakhir menerapkan kebijakan penghukuman, meningkatkan jumlah korban secara signifikan." Peluru karet dapat ditembakkan sampai 100 meter per detik. Enrique Morales Castillo, presiden departemen HAM di Chile's Medical College, mengatakan kepada BBC tidak ada negara lain yang melaporkan kasus cedera mata sebanyak ini. "Angka ini melampaui semua referensi yang kami punya," tambah Castillo. Sebagai perbandingan, studi tahun 2011 dalam konflik Israel/Palestina mencatat 154 kasus cedera mata dalam enam tahun (1987-1993). Kontroversi ini membuat pemerintah Chile menghentikan penggunaan peluru karet pada 20 November. Di Kashmir, penggunaan senapan angin oleh polisi juga menyebabkan banyak cedera mata. Rosas menekankan petugas keamanan kini hanya boleh menggunakan amunisi tidak mematikan sebagai langkah terakhir untuk membela diri bila terancam keselamatan. Tingkat cedera di Chile dikatakan setara dengan Kashmir, wilayah yang diperebutkan India dan Pakistan. Laporan BBC tahun 2018 menyebutkan lebih dari 3.000 orang di Kashmir India mengalami cedera mata akibat amunisi tak mematikan. Di Hong Kong, seorang demonstran wanita yang matanya tertembak bulan lalu menjadi simbol perlawanan terhadap aparat. Aksi penutup mata seperti di Hong Kong juga diikuti para demonstran di Chile. Wanita tak dikenal korban di Hong Kong menjadi ikon protes. Di Prancis, protes Rompi Kuning mendorong tuntutan pelarangan peluru karet karena meningkatnya cedera parah. Selama unjuk rasa di Katalunya, Spanyol, cedera mata juga banyak terjadi. Viral: foto jurnalis Palestina Muath Amarneh yang mengalami luka di mata kiri akibat peluru karet polisi Israel di Tepi Barat. Muath Amarneh kehilangan penglihatan mata kiri setelah tertembak dalam demonstrasi di Gaza. Statistik global tentang cedera dari senjata pengendalian kerumunan sulit diperoleh. Tinjauan peneliti Amerika tahun 2017 atas 26 studi sejak 1990 menunjukkan di banyak negara tidak ada kewajiban hukum mengumpulkan data cedera akibat proyektil kinetik (KIP). Hasilnya ditemukan 1.984 korban KIP di dunia, 310 di antaranya cedera mata, mayoritas juga luka kulit dan tulang. Kebutaan permanen merupakan konsekuensi berat, ditemukan pada lebih dari 84% kasus cedera mata akibat amunisi tak mematikan. Para peneliti menyimpulkan peluru karet kurang akurat dan tidak disarankan untuk pengendalian massa. "Sebagian KIP dirancang agar kecepatan berkurang di udara, tapi arahnya jadi sulit diprediksi dan akurasinya rendah," tulis mereka. Jerome Rodrigues, tokoh utama Rompi Kuning, juga mengalami cedera mata saat berdemo. Panduan PBB membolehkan polisi bertindak proporsional dalam mengendalikan massa. Namun resolusi Dewan HAM PBB menyebut KIP dapat menimbulkan cedera serius. Peluru karet dapat ditembakkan hingga 100 meter per detik. Februari 2019, Council of Europe mendesak Prancis untuk melarang peluru karet setelah Disarm Collective melaporkan 100 korban cedera serius, 17 di antaranya kebutaan satu mata (Nov 2018-Jan 2019). Menteri Dalam Negeri Prancis meragukan data tersebut dan menyatakan hanya ada empat kasus cedera mata yang diverifikasi. Namun catatan polisi Prancis menyebutkan 13.000 proyektil ditembakkan antara November 2018 dan Maret 2019. Council of Europe khawatir terhadap pelontar bola LBD di Prancis yang bisa membahayakan bila ditembakkan dari jarak dekat. Tahun 2010, Mustapha Ziani meninggal akibat serangan jantung setelah ditembak peluru karet saat bentrok dengan polisi di Marseille. Investigasi menemukan Ziani ditembak LBD dari jarak 4,4 meter, kurang dari setengah jarak aman menurut polisi Prancis. Senjata peluru karet atau pelontar bola dapat mematikan jika digunakan dari jarak dekat. Petugas yang menembak dihukum enam bulan pada 2017 atas tuduhan pembunuhan tidak disengaja. Menurut Physicians for Human Rights, hukuman atas penyalahgunaan senjata tidak mematikan jarang terjadi. Di Afrika Selatan antara 2002-2011, dari 204 kasus terkait polisi soal pengendalian massa, hanya 85 diselidiki dan satu petugas dijatuhi hukuman.
translated_content: Protesters in Chile are wearing eye patches to protest the use of rubber bullets by security forces, which have caused more than 200 eye injuries. WARNING: This article contains images of injured victims. Over the past few months, protests in major cities around the world have often ended in clashes, resulting in injuries and even fatalities. Eye injuries from crowd-control weapons, like rubber bullets, are becoming increasingly concerning. In Chile, human rights groups and health experts have recorded about 220 protesters suffering eye injuries in just one month. A report from Amnesty International accuses the Chilean government of deliberately injuring protesters. "The intention of Chilean security forces is clear: to injure those participating in demonstrations to instill fear," said Erika Guevara Rosas, Amnesty International’s Americas director, on November 21. "Over the past month, President Sebastian Pinera's administration has been implementing punitive policies, greatly increasing the number of victims." Rubber bullets can be fired at speeds of up to 100 meters per second. Enrique Morales Castillo, head of the human rights division at Chile's Medical College, told the BBC that no other country has reported this many eye injury cases. "These figures surpass all the references we have," Castillo added. For comparison, a 2011 study of the Israel/Palestine conflict reported 154 eye injuries in six years (1987–1993). The controversy has led the Chilean government to suspend the use of rubber bullets as of November 20. In Kashmir, police use of air rifles has also caused many eye injuries. Rosas stressed that security forces should now use non-lethal ammunition only as a last resort for self-defense when their safety is threatened. The level of injuries in Chile is said to be comparable to those in Kashmir, a disputed region between India and Pakistan. A 2018 BBC report stated that more than 3,000 people in Indian-controlled Kashmir suffered eye injuries from non-lethal ammunition. In Hong Kong, a female protester shot in the eye last month has become a symbol of resistance. The eye-patch protest seen in Hong Kong has also been adopted by protesters in Chile. The unidentified woman in Hong Kong has become a symbol of protest. In France, 'Yellow Vest' protests have prompted calls to ban rubber bullets due to rising numbers of serious injuries. During pro-independence protests in Catalonia, Spain, there have also been many cases of eye injuries. A viral photo showed Palestinian journalist Muath Amarneh with a wounded left eye after being hit by a rubber bullet shot by Israeli security forces in the West Bank. Muath Amarneh lost vision in his left eye after being shot during a protest in Gaza. Global statistics on injuries from crowd-control weapons are difficult to obtain. A 2017 review by a group of US researchers analyzed 26 studies conducted worldwide since 1990, revealing that in most countries there is no legal requirement for security forces to collect data on injuries caused by kinetic impact projectiles (KIPs), such as rubber bullets. The review found a total of 1,984 people injured by KIPs worldwide, with 310 suffering eye injuries (most also had skin and bone injuries). Permanent blindness is a severe consequence of eye injuries caused by non-lethal ammunition, according to the 2017 study. Permanent blindness was found in 261 cases (over 84%) of eye injuries. The research team’s conclusion was that rubber projectiles are not reliable enough for use. "Most KIPs are designed to slow down as they travel, which reduces the chance of penetrating the skin," they wrote. "However, this also causes the projectile’s path to be unpredictable and reduces its accuracy." As such, researchers concluded that KIPs are not recommended for crowd control. Jerome Rodrigues, one of the leading Yellow Vest movement figures, suffered an eye injury during protests. UN guidelines allow police to act proportionally in self-defense at protests. However, other UN human rights publications, including the Human Rights Council resolutions, highlight that KIPs can cause serious injuries. For example, rubber bullets can be fired at up to 100 meters per second. In February 2019, the Council of Europe urged France to stop using rubber bullets following a report from Disarm Collective that cited 100 cases of serious injury from KIPs between November 2018 and January 2019, including 17 cases of blindness in one eye. France’s Interior Minister disputed these numbers and said only four cases of eye injury among protesters had been verified. Nevertheless, police records indicate that 13,000 projectiles were fired between November 2018 and March 2019 in response to protests. French police fired more than 13,000 rubber bullets in that period. The Council of Europe is especially concerned about the use of the LBD launcher, which fires rubber or foam projectiles and can be fatal if fired at close range. In 2010, a man named Mustapha Ziani died of a heart attack after being shot in the chest with a rubber bullet during clashes with police in Marseille, France. An investigation found that police shot Ziani with an LBD from 4.4 meters away — less than half the safety distance recommended by French police. Weapons like rubber bullets or launchers can be fatal if fired at close range. The officer involved was sentenced to six months in 2017 for involuntary manslaughter. According to the US-based NGO Physicians for Human Rights, it is rare for officers to be punished for the misuse of non-lethal weapons. According to the organization, between 2002 and 2011 in South Africa, out of 204 allegations against police for crowd-control, only 85 were investigated, and just one officer was convicted.

Pemerintah Kurdi di Suriah Utara mengusulkan pembentukan pengadilan internasional untuk mengadili ribuan tersangka anggota ISIS. Abdul Karim Omar, pejabat urusan luar negeri Kurdi, mengatakan bahwa pihaknya kewalahan mengelola para tahanan yang keluar dari wilayah terakhir ISIS di Baghuz. Pasukan Demokratik Suriah (SDF) yang dipimpin Kurdi baru-baru ini merebut area tersebut dan kini menahan ribuan orang, termasuk sekitar 1.000 pejuang asing dari 50 negara di sejumlah penjara.

ISIS sebelumnya menguasai sekitar 88.000 kilometer persegi wilayah di Suriah dan Irak. Setelah kehilangan wilayah, menurut AS, diperkirakan masih ada 15.000-20.000 anggota ISIS yang bersembunyi di tengah masyarakat.

Pihak Kurdi menekankan perlunya pengadilan internasional di timur laut Suriah untuk menjamin proses peradilan yang adil dan sesuai hukum internasional. Namun, hanya sedikit negara yang mau memulangkan warganya yang pernah bergabung dengan ISIS, sehingga situasinya semakin rumit. Banyak negara Barat enggan merepatriasi warganya karena alasan keamanan dan demi pengumpulan bukti.

Sejak Januari, SDF yang didukung AS telah menahan lebih dari 5.000 militan, baik dari Suriah maupun luar negeri. Anak-anak dan perempuan keluarga ISIS ditempatkan di kamp pengungsi, termasuk al-Hol yang kini menampung lebih dari 70.000 orang (melebihi kapasitas aslinya 20.000). Lebih dari 9.000 anggota asing ISIS, termasuk banyak anak-anak, berada di kamp ini.

James Jeffrey, utusan AS untuk Suriah, menyatakan bahwa fokus utama kini adalah memulangkan warga dari negara masing-masing untuk menjalani deradikalisasi, reintegrasi, atau penegakan hukum. Meski demikian, beberapa kasus seperti Hoda Muthana—yang ditolak kembali ke Amerika Serikat—menggambarkan kesulitan dalam proses repatriasi karena masalah kewarganegaraan dan kebijakan pemerintah.

Sampai saat ini, Amerika Serikat belum mempertimbangkan pembentukan pengadilan internasional. Pakar hukum internasional, Joel Hubrecht, menilai pembentukan pengadilan di wilayah Kurdi Suriah tidak realistis, mengingat otoritas Kurdi belum diakui secara internasional dan perlindungan saksi di kawasan konflik sangat sulit.
translated_content:
Kurdish authorities in Northern Syria have proposed setting up an international court to try thousands of suspected ISIS members. Abdul Karim Omar, the Kurdish official for foreign affairs, said they are overwhelmed managing detainees coming from ISIS’s last stronghold in Baghuz. The Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) recently recaptured this area and are now detaining thousands of people, including approximately 1,000 foreign fighters from 50 different countries in various prisons.

At its height, ISIS controlled around 88,000 square kilometers across Syria and Iraq. After losing most of its territory, US officials estimate there are still 15,000–20,000 ISIS members hiding among the population.

Kurdish authorities are emphasizing the need for an international tribunal in northeast Syria to secure fair trials under international law. Yet, only a few countries have agreed to take back nationals who joined ISIS, complicating the situation further. Many Western governments are reluctant to repatriate their citizens due to safety concerns and the need for evidence collection.

Since January, the SDF, with US backing, has detained more than 5,000 militants from both inside and outside Syria. Children and women from ISIS families have been kept in refugee camps, most notably al-Hol, which now holds over 70,000 people, far exceeding its original capacity of 20,000. More than 9,000 foreign ISIS affiliates, including numerous children, are in this camp.

James Jeffrey, the US special envoy for Syria, stated that the main priority is to get countries to take back their citizens for deradicalization, reintegration, or prosecution. However, cases like Hoda Muthana—denied reentry into the US—illustrate how issues of citizenship and policy create obstacles for repatriation.

The US has not considered an international court. International law expert Joel Hubrecht believes a tribunal in Kurdish-controlled Syria is unrealistic, because Kurdish authorities are not internationally recognized and protecting witnesses in such a conflict zone is very difficult.

article_content: Saksi mata melaporkan bahwa perempuan dan anak-anak turut menjadi korban dalam insiden tersebut. Kepolisian Pakistan menyatakan sedikitnya 63 orang tewas akibat ledakan bom di kota Quetta, Pakistan barat daya, pada Sabtu, 16 Februari 2013. Sekitar 180 orang lainnya mengalami luka-luka dalam ledakan yang terjadi di kawasan pemukiman warga Hazara di kota itu. Bom meledak usai tengah hari di sebuah pasar yang ramai, berdekatan dengan sekolah bahasa dan pusat komputer. Perwira polisi Pakistan, Wazir Khan Nasir, mengatakan komunitas Syiah menjadi sasaran serangan. Ia menambahkan, ledakan disebabkan bahan peledak yang ditempatkan di sepeda motor, meskipun terdapat laporan lain yang menyebutkan bom diletakkan di sebuah becak. Para saksi mata membenarkan bahwa jumlah korban jiwa termasuk anak-anak dan perempuan. Tidak lama setelah serangan terjadi, massa yang marah melempari polisi dan sempat menghalangi polisi serta petugas penyelamat memasuki lokasi kejadian. Keluarga korban sebelumnya juga pernah menolak pemakaman jenazah pada serangan di bulan Januari. Serangan ini menjadi yang kedua menimpa masyarakat Hazara, komunitas Syiah di Quetta, dalam kurun lima pekan terakhir. Ketegangan di Quetta meningkat; umat Syiah menuding pemerintah gagal memberikan perlindungan dari serangan sektarian. Juru bicara kelompok militan terlarang Lashkar-e-Jhangvi telah mengklaim bertanggung jawab atas serangan ini, seperti disampaikan kepada kantor berita Reuters. Kelompok yang sama juga mengklaim serangan sebelumnya pada Januari lalu, yang tergolong salah satu insiden terburuk di Pakistan dalam beberapa tahun terakhir. Quetta merupakan ibu kota Provinsi Balochistan yang berada di perbatasan Iran dan Afghanistan; wilayah ini kerap dilanda kekerasan akibat konflik sektarian dan gerakan separatis.
translated_content: Eyewitnesses reported that women and children were among the victims. Pakistani police stated that at least 63 people were killed in a bombing in Quetta, southwestern Pakistan, on Saturday, February 16, 2013. About 180 others were injured in the explosion that occurred in the Hazara residential area of the city. The bomb exploded after midday in a crowded market, near a language school and computer center. Pakistani police officer Wazir Khan Nasir said the Shiite community was targeted in the attack. He added that the explosion was caused by explosives placed on a motorcycle, although other reports said the bomb was placed in a rickshaw. Witnesses confirmed that the fatalities included children and women. Shortly after the attack, an angry crowd threw stones at the police and temporarily prevented police and rescue workers from entering the site. Previously, victims' families had refused to bury the bodies in the aftermath of the attack in January. This is the second attack to hit the Hazara community, a Shiite group in Quetta, within the past five weeks. Tensions in Quetta have risen; Shiites blame the authorities for failing to protect them against sectarian attacks. A spokesperson for the banned militant group Lashkar-e-Jhangvi claimed responsibility for the attack, as reported by Reuters. The same group also claimed responsibility for the previous attack in January, which was considered one of the worst incidents in Pakistan in recent years. Quetta is the capital of Balochistan Province, located near the borders of Iran and Afghanistan; this area has often experienced violence arising from sectarian conflict and separatist movements.

Wilayah pesisir di sekitar kawasan wisata Pelabuhan Ratu, Sukabumi, Jawa Barat, dilanda banjir setelah hujan deras mengguyur selama sekitar empat jam. Akibatnya, kawasan pelabuhan dan tempat pelelangan ikan Pelabuhan Ratu terendam air.

Tidak ada korban jiwa dalam insiden ini, namun setidaknya 20 rumah dilaporkan terdampak banjir, menurut Kepala BPBD Jawa Barat, Haryadi Wargadikarta. Ia menyatakan bahwa air mulai surut, tetapi hujan susulan masih bisa terjadi sesuai prakiraan BMKG.

Area yang paling terdampak adalah Kampung Babakan Gumelar, Kelurahan Pelabuhan Ratu, Kecamatan Pelabuhan Ratu, Kabupaten Sukabumi. Hujan mulai turun sejak pukul 09.00 WIB pada Sabtu (14/1) dan berlangsung sekitar empat jam.

Situs BMKG juga memprakirakan hujan lebat akan mengguyur beberapa wilayah lain di hari Minggu, seperti Aceh, Bangka Belitung, Bali, Banten, NTT, dan Papua. Di beberapa daerah, hujan tersebut mungkin disertai angin kencang dan petir.
translated_content:
The coastal area near the Pelabuhan Ratu tourist area in Sukabumi, West Java, was hit by flooding after heavy rain fell for about four hours. As a result, the harbor and the Pelabuhan Ratu fish auction center were submerged.

No fatalities were reported, but at least 20 houses were affected, said Haryadi Wargadikarta, Head of the West Java Regional Disaster Management Agency (BPBD). He noted that water levels have started to recede, though further rainfall remains possible according to forecasts from the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG).

The area most affected was Babakan Gumelar Village, Pelabuhan Ratu Subdistrict, Pelabuhan Ratu District, Sukabumi Regency. The rain started at 9:00 a.m. WIB on Saturday (14/1) and continued for about four hours.

The BMKG website also forecasts heavy rains for other regions on Sunday, including Aceh, Bangka Belitung, Bali, Banten, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), and Papua. In some areas, heavy rain may be accompanied by strong winds and lightning.

article_content: Pemerintah Cina berencana membuka 13 juta lapangan kerja selama lima tahun ke depan dengan berinvestasi sebesar US$361 miliar atau sekitar Rp4.811 triliun di bidang energi terbarukan. Rencana ini tercantum dalam dokumen cetak biru Badan Energi Nasional yang menguraikan strategi pengembangan sektor energi periode 2016-2020. Badan tersebut menambahkan bahwa kapasitas energi terbarukan, termasuk tenaga angin, air, surya, dan nuklir, ditargetkan dapat memasok sekitar 50% dari penambahan kapasitas listrik baru sebelum tahun 2020. Badan Energi Nasional belum merinci alokasi investasi untuk masing-masing sektor energi. Meski demikian, Cina telah menempatkan transisi ke energi ramah lingkungan sebagai prioritas politik utama. Langkah ini didorong oleh polusi kronis yang disebabkan oleh pembangkit listrik tenaga batu bara. Beberapa wilayah di utara Cina dalam beberapa minggu terakhir diselimuti kabut asap tebal yang berbahaya. Wartawan BBC di Beijing, John Sudworth, melaporkan bahwa walaupun investasi ini sangat besar, rencana tersebut masih dinilai belum seambisius target sebelumnya. Selain itu, banyak pihak masih meragukan tercapainya target-target pemerintah tersebut. Menurut Paolo Frankl, kepala divisi energi terbarukan di Badan Energi Internasional (IEA) yang berbasis di Paris, program baru ini dihadapkan pada beberapa tantangan. Tantangan yang dimaksud antara lain, pemerintah Cina harus menanggung peningkatan subsidi, serta memperkuat jaringan listrik agar dapat menyalurkan energi dari daerah kaya sumber angin dan surya ke kota-kota di bagian timur.
translated_content: The Chinese government plans to create 13 million jobs over the next five years by investing US$361 billion, or about Rp4.811 trillion, in the renewable energy sector. This plan is outlined in a blueprint from the National Energy Administration, which details energy sector development strategies for the 2016-2020 period. The agency also states that renewable energy capacity—including wind, hydro, solar, and nuclear—is targeted to contribute about 50% of new electricity generation additions before 2020. The National Energy Administration has not specified the investment allocation for each energy sector. Nevertheless, China has placed the transition to environmentally friendly energy as a top political priority. This move is driven by chronic pollution caused by coal power plants. In recent weeks, several regions in northern China have been engulfed by hazardous smog. BBC reporter John Sudworth in Beijing reported that although the investment is substantial, the plan is still viewed as less ambitious compared to previous targets. Furthermore, many observers remain skeptical about the government achieving its targets. According to Paolo Frankl, head of the renewable energy division at the International Energy Agency (IEA) in Paris, the new program faces several challenges. These challenges include the need for the Chinese government to shoulder increasing subsidies, as well as the strengthening of the power grid to deliver energy from wind- and solar-rich regions to cities in the east.

article_content: Pelatih tim nasional Italia, Cesare Prandelli, meminta maaf setelah membuat komentar bercanda tentang Mario Balotelli, yang disebutnya hanya diizinkan keluar hotel saat Piala Konfederasi di Brasil karena berkulit hitam. Sebelumnya, penasehat keamanan turnamen telah meminta semua tim melarang pemain keluar hotel selama gelombang unjuk rasa menimpa Brasil. Prandelli mengatakan bahwa striker AC Milan itu boleh meninggalkan hotel karena ia 'berwarna berbeda dengan kita', namun ia segera mengklarifikasi: 'Itu hanya lelucon...' Prandelli mengizinkan Balotelli keluar hotel setelah mengetahui ia terlibat dalam kegiatan amal membantu anak-anak kurang mampu di wilayah Salvador, Brasil. Prandelli merasa lega setelah dapat mengklarifikasi maksud di balik komentarnya tentang warna kulit Balotelli. 'Sebelumnya saya memang menyampaikan sesuatu soal warna kulit,' ujar Prandelli. 'Tapi saya senang bisa menjelaskan kenapa dia akhirnya diizinkan meninggalkan hotel.' Dalam konferensi pers menjelang laga Italia melawan Brasil pada Sabtu, Prandelli mengatakan timnya tidak mempertimbangkan untuk pulang, meskipun terjadi unjuk rasa yang berubah menjadi kekerasan. 'Pulang ke rumah bukan pilihan yang kami pikirkan,' katanya. Ia juga mengakui situasi di Rio telah berubah. 'Dulu kami bisa mengunjungi kota, sekarang kami dilarang meninggalkan hotel.' Menurutnya, ia memahami aksi unjuk rasa damai yang menuntut perubahan, tapi menyesalkan jika berubah menjadi tindakan anarkis. Sementara itu, Riccardo Montolivo, gelandang AC Milan, mengecam kekerasan di Brasil dan menegaskan: 'Kekerasan tidak dapat diterima untuk alasan apa pun.' Pada Minggu (23/6) dini hari WIB, Italia akan menghadapi Brasil memperebutkan posisi puncak grup Piala Konfederasi. Kedua tim berusaha memenangkan laga agar terhindar bertemu Spanyol yang diprediksi menjadi juara grup lawan.
translated_content: Italy's national team coach, Cesare Prandelli, has apologized after making a joke about Mario Balotelli, saying he was only allowed to leave the hotel during the Confederations Cup in Brazil because he is black. Earlier, tournament security advisors had asked all teams to prevent their players from leaving the hotel during waves of protests in Brazil. Prandelli said the AC Milan striker was permitted to leave because he is 'a different color than us', but quickly clarified: 'That was just a joke...' Prandelli allowed Balotelli to go outside after learning he was participating in charity work supporting underprivileged children in the Salvador area of Brazil. Prandelli felt relieved after being able to clarify the intent behind his comment about Balotelli's skin color. 'Earlier, I did say something about skin color,' Prandelli stated. 'But I'm glad I could explain why he was finally allowed to leave the hotel.' At a press conference ahead of Italy's match against Brazil on Saturday, Prandelli said his team was not considering leaving, despite protests that had escalated into violence. 'Going home is not something we're thinking about,' he said. He also acknowledged that conditions in Rio had changed. 'We used to be able to visit the city, but now we're not allowed to leave the hotel.' He said he understood peaceful demonstrations seeking change, but regretted when they turned anarchic. Meanwhile, AC Milan midfielder Riccardo Montolivo condemned the violence in Brazil, stating: 'Violence cannot be accepted for any reason.' On Sunday (June 23) early morning WIB, Italy will face Brazil competing for the top spot in their Confederations Cup group. Both teams aim to win to avoid meeting Spain, who are predicted to top the other group.

article_content: Sejumlah warga Indonesia yang tinggal di Rusia rela mengeluarkan biaya lebih demi mendapatkan tiket untuk menonton langsung pertandingan Piala Dunia 2018. Tiket-tiket tersebut mereka dapatkan melalui transaksi daring. Begitu FIFA mulai menjual tiket, Ruben Sumigar, WNI yang menetap di Rusia, langsung memantau komputer dan ikut antre online. "Saat (sistem online) pertama kali dibuka, saya antre sekitar delapan sampai sembilan jam," kata Ben—sapaan akrab Ruben—kepada Clara Rondonuwu dari BBC News Indonesia. Setelah masuk antrean, waktu tenggang hanya 10 menit untuk menyelesaikan transaksi. "Kalau kita lupa waktu dan tidak transaksi, tiket hangus dan harus menunggu beberapa jam lagi." Ben menyebut, biasanya tidak semua pertandingan bisa dibeli sekaligus. Seringkali transaksinya gagal. FIFA menggunakan sistem ini untuk mengatur distribusi tiket di setiap fase penjualan. Meski sudah menghabiskan waktu lama, Ben akhirnya hanya mendapat satu tiket babak penyisihan, untuk laga Denmark vs Prancis di Moskow. Ia berencana mencari tiket lagi untuk tahap berikutnya seperti 16 besar dan perempat final, selama penjualan masih dibuka. Ben pun selalu siap mengikuti prosedur panjang, bahkan datang langsung ke pusat penjualan di Dobryninskaya, Moskow. Sebagai penggemar tim Inggris, Ben mengaku menonton langsung Piala Dunia di Rusia adalah pengalaman luar biasa. "Piala Dunia pertama saya di Jepang 2002, tapi di Rusia suasananya jauh lebih ramai," ujarnya. Sementara itu, Yoan Clara Teken, WNI penggemar Brasil, ingin mengembalikan tiket yang sudah dibeli secara online. "Saya sudah beli tiket Iran vs Spanyol tanggal 20 Juni, tapi setelah dihitung, ongkos ke luar Moskow mahal, jadi saya berubah pikiran." Tiket tersebut ia beli seharga 12.600 rubel (~Rp2,8 juta), belum termasuk ongkos ke Kazan Arena yang jaraknya 90 km dari Moskow. "Biaya transportasi dan penginapan jadi setara tiket kategori dua untuk laga pembuka di Moskow, makanya saya cari tiket opening," jelasnya. Yoan akhirnya dapat tiket opening kategori satu seharga 33 ribu rubel (~Rp7,2 juta), meski harus menambah dana. "Transportasi dan akomodasi sudah naik dua sampai tiga kali lipat dari harga normal," katanya, "jadi lebih baik pilih pertandingan di Moskow saja." Sudah berdomisili enam tahun di Moskow, Yoan mulai berburu tiket sejak awal 2018, biasanya mulai pukul 22.00 dan baru mendapat tiket sekitar pukul 3 pagi. "Akses beli tiket online akhir 2017 dan awal 2018 sangat susah," akunya. Yoan akhirnya memilih mengembalikan tiket Iran vs Spanyol ke FIFA dengan potongan 10% harga tiket, sesuai aturan maksimal tiga hari sebelum laga. Setelah merasakan laga pembuka, ia semakin antusias dan ingin terus mencoba mendapatkan tiket, meski bukan kategori satu atau dua. "Kalau dapat lagi, saya akan berburu setiap malam lewat situs FIFA," pungkasnya.
translated_content: Several Indonesians living in Russia are willing to spend extra money to get tickets to watch the 2018 World Cup matches live. They obtained these tickets through online transactions. As soon as FIFA began selling tickets, Ruben Sumigar, an Indonesian residing in Russia, immediately monitored his computer and joined the online queue. "When the online system first opened, I queued for about eight to nine hours," said Ben—Ruben’s nickname—to Clara Rondonuwu from BBC News Indonesia. Once in the queue, there’s only a 10-minute window to complete the transaction. "If we lose track of time and don't finish, the tickets are gone and we have to wait several hours again." Ben stated that usually not all matches can be purchased at once. Often, the transaction fails. FIFA uses this system to manage ticket distribution at each sales phase. Even after spending a lot of time, Ben only managed to get one group-stage ticket, for the Denmark vs. France match in Moscow. He plans to look for more tickets for later rounds like the round of 16 and quarter-finals, as long as sales are still open. Ben is always ready to go through the lengthy process, even coming directly to the ticketing center at Dobryninskaya, Moscow. As a fan of the England team, Ben said watching the World Cup live in Russia was an incredible experience. "My first World Cup was in Japan 2002, but the atmosphere in Russia feels much more lively," he said. Meanwhile, Yoan Clara Teken, an Indonesian supporter of Brazil, wants to return a ticket she bought online. "I already bought a ticket for Iran vs. Spain on June 20, but after calculating, traveling outside Moscow is expensive, so I changed my mind." She bought the ticket for 12,600 rubles (~Rp2.8 million), not including the transport cost to Kazan Arena, which is 90 km from Moscow. "The transport and lodging costs are equal to a category two ticket for the opening match in Moscow, so I looked for an opening ticket instead," she explained. Yoan eventually got a category one opening ticket for 33,000 rubles (~Rp7.2 million), although she had to top up more money. "Transport and accommodation have gone up two to three times from normal prices," she said, "so it's better to choose matches in Moscow." Having lived in Moscow for six years, Yoan started hunting tickets from early 2018, usually starting at 10 p.m. and only getting tickets at about 3 a.m. "Accessing ticket sales online at the end of 2017 and early 2018 was very difficult," she admitted. Yoan eventually decided to return the Iran vs. Spain ticket to FIFA with a 10% penalty, as per the rule if done no later than three days before the match. After experiencing the opening match, she became even more enthusiastic and wants to keep trying to get more tickets, even if they're not category one or two. "If I get more tickets, I’ll keep hunting every night through the FIFA website," she concluded.

article_content: Sepasang orang tua di negara bagian Georgia, AS, memenangkan pertarungan hukum untuk memberi nama belakang 'Allah' pada putri mereka. Sebelumnya, pejabat negara bagian menolak menerbitkan akta kelahiran atas nama ZalyKha Graceful Lorraina Allah karena kedua orang tuanya tidak memiliki nama belakang 'Allah'. Serikat Kebebasan Sipil Amerika (ACLU) membawa kasus ini ke pengadilan dan menyebut keputusan tersebut sebagai kemenangan atas kebebasan berekspresi. Kelompok advokasi Muslim terbesar di AS menyampaikan bahwa penggunaan nama tersebut dapat dianggap menyinggung. Pada awalnya, Departemen Kesehatan Georgia menyatakan anak perempuan pasangan Elizabeth Handy dan Bilal Walk hanya boleh memakai nama keluarga Handy atau Walk, atau gabungannya, bukan 'Allah'. Handy dan Walk mengatakan bahwa dua anak laki-laki mereka sebelumnya diizinkan memakai nama belakang 'Allah'. Undang-undang Georgia mengizinkan nama apapun selama tidak dinilai provokatif atau menyinggung. Namun, Dewan Hubungan Islam Amerika (CAIR) menyebut penggunaan 'Allah' sebagai nama keluarga tidak peka secara budaya. Direktur CAIR, Nihad Awad, menjelaskan bahwa beberapa nama Arab merujuk kepada Tuhan, seperti Abdullah yang berarti 'hamba Tuhan', namun tidak pernah menggunakan 'Allah' sebagai nama karena dianggap sangat tidak pantas. Andrea Young dari ACLU menyatakan keputusan ini penting untuk penegakan hak orang tua. Ia menegaskan pemerintah tidak seharusnya membatasi pilihan nama untuk anak-anak. Pasangan Handy dan Walk—yang menantikan anak keempat—menyambut keputusan ini, karena kini putri mereka dapat memiliki nomor jaminan sosial, mendaftar sekolah, dan menerima manfaat pemerintah. Pasangan ini kepada Atlanta Journal-Constitution pada Maret lalu menyatakan memilih nama 'Allah' karena dianggap mulia, bukan karena alasan agama.
translated_content: A couple in Georgia, USA, won a legal battle to give their daughter the last name 'Allah.' Previously, state officials refused to issue a birth certificate for ZalyKha Graceful Lorraina Allah because neither parent had 'Allah' as their last name. The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) brought the case to court, calling the decision a victory for freedom of expression. The largest Muslim advocacy group in the US suggested that using the name could be considered offensive. Initially, the Georgia Department of Health stated that the daughter of Elizabeth Handy and Bilal Walk could only use the family names Handy or Walk, or a combination, but not 'Allah.' Handy and Walk noted that their two sons had previously been allowed to use the surname 'Allah.' Georgia law allows any name as long as it is not deemed provocative or offensive. However, the Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR) argued that using 'Allah' as a surname is culturally insensitive. CAIR director Nihad Awad explained that some Arabic names refer to God, such as Abdullah meaning 'servant of God,' but Allah itself is never used as a name because it is considered highly inappropriate. Andrea Young from the ACLU stated that this decision is important for asserting parental rights. She stressed that the government should not restrict what names parents can choose for their children. Handy and Walk—who are expecting their fourth child—welcomed this decision, as it allows their daughter to obtain a social security number, enroll in school, and access government benefits. The couple told the Atlanta Journal-Constitution last March that they chose the name 'Allah' because they consider it noble, not for religious reasons.
